name: Explicit Allowed Set Obfuscation
description: Replaces the algebraic inequality constraint with an exhaustive list of allowed unordered pairs, forcing models to interpret the rule as a generic constraint rather than immediately mapping it to the inequality operator and graph coloring. This aims to prevent the activation of graph-coloring-specific heuristics like DSATUR or MRV, causing generic backtracking solutions to fail the time limit on challenging test cases.
